notes: Datasheet SLOS068AB covers LM158/258/358/2904 families; reference variant is LM358B (section 5.5, pages 6-7). Note: LM358B is not offered in P (PDIP); per Package Information P is LM358/LM358A/LM258/LM2904 - pinout is identical (Figure 4-1). Legacy LM358/LM358A table (section 5.7, page 10, VS = 5 V) has different values (VOS 3/7 mV, GBW 0.7 MHz, SR 0.3 V/us) and is NOT included. Values printed with ± are stored as magnitudes (sign noted in conditions); IB and source IO stored with printed negative sign. Values that are rail expressions ((V–), (V+) – 1.5, etc.) or impedance pairs (10 || 0.1) are stored as null with expression in conditions. PyMuPDF renders the en-dash/minus in pin names as '±' (e.g. 'IN1±', 'V±') in the pin diagram; pin table shows 'IN1–', 'V–'. V– is labeled 'V–' (not GND) so role is POWER. Datasheet has no 'GND' label. IQ 300/460 row is printed with both 25°C and TA = –40°C to +85°C condition lines; ambiguous which applies to max.
